title: Daniel P NDE 5102
content: I remember at the gas station where I was shot looking down and seeing my internal organs lying in the ground and knowing that death was soon upon me before I passed out. I remember asking for grace and peace in this moment. Then I passed out. I next remember going to a place that was not far away and being surrounded by an aura and general pain free existence. I was also having like fleeting thoughts of my children's lives and my life and the good and bad that I went through. It was all so fast and so colorful, but like faded and had a haze to it. Then I remember that I was trying to pull these thoughts into place and make sense of what I was seeing. The haze started to clear. Then I could see my daughters and their faces plain and in front of me - I was trying to reach them and I couldn't. As this became so hard I remember, waking in the helicopter and seeing the trauma nurse and then the pain was unbearable. Then in surgery, I can remember going out from the drugs, and I was like dreaming and living in a place that was clearly not from earth. I was looking down at myself in the hospital I think but not sure - all I know is that as nice as this felt, I had the need to get back to this body and what was going on. It was like a struggle because I had this wonderful sensation knowing that this was a definite good warm place and that I had been forgiven. Yet the desire to get back was overwhelming and I tried to cry out and nothing would come out, not a sound. I kept yelling and saying I wanted to come home and there was nothing, no sound to be heard anywhere, just total peace and tranquility and warmth. At this point, there were no fleeting thoughts of family and friends because I knew that I was dead or dying - but still the urge to move back into my body was strong and the desire to live was phenomenal. Finally the total picture was gone, everything, and somewhere in there I was back and woke up in recovery.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described being in a nearby place with an "aura," "pain free existence," and later "total peace and tranquility and warmth," with imagery that was "so fast and so colorful" but "faded and had a haze to it."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: The experience "was gone" and "somewhere in there" he was back and woke up in recovery.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Shot at a gas station; later in helicopter and surgery.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two episodes described: (1) after being shot and passing out; (2) during surgery drugs, with a clearly unearthly place and urge/struggle to return to the body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE at shooting scene, then brief life-review-like thoughts and imagery; later during surgery another unearthly realm/OBE-like perspective and then return to body.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Two separated altered-state/NDE-like segments (after shooting; during surgery).

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported seeing "internal organs lying in the ground" after being shot. Reported inability to make sound while trying to yell/cry out in the peaceful realm ("nothing would come out, not a sound").
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I was shot looking down and seeing my internal organs lying in the ground"; "It was all so fast and so colorful, but like faded and had a haze to it."; "I kept yelling and saying I wanted to come home and there was nothing, no sound to be heard anywhere, just total peace and tranquility and warmth."
